title: Cohesion, Coupling & Dependency Direction
objectives: Explain cohesion and coupling with concrete code smells
Point dependency arrows in one direction only
Recognize high-cohesion module boundaries in Rust and Vue

examples.name: invoice.rs

exercise.prompt: Classify each dependency as HEALTHY or BACKWARD: "component -> composable", "service -> domain", "domain -> vue component", "store -> api client". Render one verdict per line.
hints: Domain logic must never know about UI or transport layers.
UI calling composables/services is the normal, healthy direction.

questions.prompt: A domain module imports a DTO type from the HTTP layer. What is wrong?
options: The dependency arrow points backwards (domain to transport)
DTOs should be defined in the domain
Only Vue projects have this rule
questions.explanation: Domain logic must not depend on transport concerns; the transport layer maps DTOs to domain types instead.

options: modules share as much code as possible
code that changes together lives together
questions.explanation: High cohesion groups related behavior; it is about relationships between code, not file size.
